name: container-scroll
title: Container Scroll
blurb: Card rotates and scales as you scroll, with parallax title.
description: Scroll-driven 3D effect: content card rotates and scales on scroll, title parallax translates. Exports title, card, and container subcomponents.
use_when: Product showcase sections, scroll-reveal demos, or 3D presentation flows.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (scroll-triggered, no prefers-reduced-motion); low-end devices.
a11y: Scroll-driven animation only. No interactive elements beyond content.
